summary.text: Chris Swedzinski is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 15A.
The House member page lists his occupation as farmer and says he was first elected in 2010, now in his eighth term.

paragraphs.text: His education is listed as B.S. degrees in history and in political science from Minnesota State University, Mankato.
His committee assignments include Energy Finance and Policy, Taxes, and Ways and Means.
His profile lists his family as married to Jessica, with five children.

sources.title: Rep. Chris Swedzinski (15A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
